name: Thawing Feelings
source:
Is your heart frozen?

With adulthood on the horizon, seemingly endless days of freedom are coming to an end, with one question still looming on your mind. So, just what does it mean to be in love? As the balance between your closest friends and the newest people in your life begins to tip, one final chance at an idealised, young love soon presents itself as these feelings begin to settle.

Thawing Feelings follows the lives of three university students as their past, present and futures become frosted with uncertainty, as a bittersweet winter affair is soon orchestrated.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ds-sans/thawing-feelings-adult-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
你的心被冰冻了吗？

随着成年期的临近，看似无尽的自由日子即将结束，但有一个问题仍然萦绕在你的脑海中。那么，恋爱到底意味着什么呢？当你最亲密的朋友和你生命中新认识的人之间的平衡开始倾斜时，随着这些感情开始安定下来，理想化的、年轻的爱情的最后机会很快就会出现。

《解冻情感》讲述了三名大学生的生活，他们的过去、现在和未来都充满了不确定性，一场苦乐参半的冬季事件很快就上演了。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ds-sans/thawing-feelings-adult-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
